title: Concept: Lockfile nests duplicate copies of a package
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile that nests a second copy of a package inside another dependency, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Two copies of the same package mean the tree ships code the top-level review never saw, and a patched top-level version can be shadowed by the nested one.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Two copies of the same package mean the tree ships code the top-level review never saw, and a patched top-level version can be shadowed by the nested one.
